title: Extracting Explainable Temporal Features in Multivariate Time Series Classification Pipelines

problem.claim: Explainability is increasingly needed for multivariate time series classification models used in real-world decision-making.

gap.claim: Existing approaches either produce opaque feature descriptors or depend on specific model architectures.

narrative_sequence.summary: MTSC is an important task across healthcare, finance, and industrial monitoring.
Real-world use of MTSC models creates a critical need for explainability.
Current solutions are limited by opaque descriptors or architecture-specific explainable models.

unknowns: The proposed method or system is not specified.
